Gold impression: gastroenteritis ?viral/?food poisoning. Generated asm-001: acute infectious gastroenteritis, likely viral given contacts. This covers the gastroenteritis with likely viral etiology; omission of “?food” is an omission of a differential but still covers the main diagnosis.

Gold: if ongoing with fever, stool culture to exclude bacterial origin. Generated plan-002: if seen, send stool sample for culture/MC&S to exclude bacterial pathogens. This captures the intent to send stool culture to rule out bacterial infection; link to fever is omitted but core plan is covered.
Gold: continue taking small sips ORT constantly. Generated plan-003: continue ORS in very small, frequent sips, avoid large boluses. This matches the oral rehydration advice.

Gold: booked for urgent appointment to assess hydration. Generated plan-001: arrange urgent clinic appointment for stool specimen collection and hydration assessment with patient agreeing. This covers an urgent appointment including hydration assessment.

Gold: if feels worse, abdominal pain, unwell, contact clinic to arrange urgent A&E assessment. The safety-netting to escalate to urgent A&E-type care when worse is covered, though criteria are elaborated differently.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold chief complaint is only diarrhoea. Duration (3 days) is in HPI, and vomiting as part of the CC is not stated. Thus this combines and adds elements not specified as the chief complaint.

Gold confirms watery stools and four BMs by midday, but does not state that diarrhea began watery and then became very loose or that there are ≥4 stools today (without time qualifier). The progression detail is additional.
Gold notes vomiting and difficulty keeping fluids down but does not specify multiple episodes, nor mention inability to keep tea down. These are added details.
Timing of last vomiting episode (this morning after breakfast) is not provided in Gold. This is new information.
Gold: feels hot but hasn't checked temperature. Generated: subjective fever, ‘literally boiling,’ no thermometer reading. This is consistent with the gold description.

Gold: periumbilical cramps, waves, worse when needs to open bowels. Generated adds tenderness to touch; association with urge to defecate is consistent, but ‘tender to touch’ is additional detail not in Gold.
Gold: still passing urine, last 1 hr ago, not sure of colour. Generated: passed ~1 hr ago; no visible blood. Gold does not state absence of blood; this is an added negative finding.
Gold explicitly says no blood in stool. Generated restates this as no blood in stool reported. Fully supported.

Gold mentions brother and mother with similar symptoms, but no reference to a school outbreak. Generated mentions a school outbreak and only the brother. The brother exposure is supported, school outbreak is additional, and omission of mother makes it incomplete but not contradictory.
Gold: ORT regularly, difficulty keeping down. Generated gives specific regime (salt/sugar mix ~3x/day x2 days). Frequency, duration, and preparation details are not in Gold and are additions.
Gold: PMH: Nil (no significant past medical history). Generated: menstrual cramps as only PMH. This introduces a condition where Gold states none.
Gold: vitamins. Generated: Vitamin D daily. This is a more specific form of vitamin use and is consistent.
Use of ‘naprine’ PRN for cramps is not mentioned in Gold at all. This is additional medication information.
Gold: non-smoker. Generated: non-smoker. Fully supported.

Gold: drinks 1 pint a week (specific weekly quantity). Generated: occasional alcohol, sometimes a pint. This alters frequency and is not strictly supported; it is a modified characterization of intake rather than a direct contradiction, so treated as an addition/inexact paraphrase.

Gold: works as graphic designer and separately notes that she has been at work until today and is now working from home. Generated includes working from home today in Social/Family section; the WFH today information is present in Gold HPI, but its placement as SH and the combined statement represent a rephrasing with some added context. The occupation itself is supported (sh-004), but the specific integration here is partially additional.
Gold: lives with brother and mother. Generated: lives with her brother and mother. Direct match.

Gold: ‘No regular SI’ (not regularly sexually active but not necessarily completely inactive) and ‘not using contraception.’ Generated: ‘not sexually active’ and ‘not on contraception.’ The contraception part is supported, but asserting ‘not sexually active’ is stronger than ‘no regular SI’ and may conflict with the Gold description, so this is treated as a contradiction.

Gold: gastroenteritis ?viral/?food poisoning. Generated: acute infectious gastroenteritis, likely viral given contacts. This is compatible with the gold impression, emphasizing the viral side without denying possible food poisoning.
Risk of dehydration due to vomiting and poor intake is clinically reasonable but not explicitly articulated as a separate assessment item in Gold.

Gold describes periumbilical cramps coming in waves and worse with need to open bowels. Generated asm-003 restates periumbilical abdominal pain intermittent and associated with stooling as an assessment item. Concept is supported.
Gold: feels hot, hasn't checked temperature (subjective fever). Generated: assessed as having subjective fever. Supported.

Gold follow-up: urgent appointment to assess hydration status is booked. Gold plan: stool culture if ongoing with fever. Generated plan-001 merges these and specifies ‘via support line’ and that the appointment is for stool specimen collection and hydration assessment, which adds process details (support line, explicit stool collection at that visit) not in Gold.

Gold: if ongoing with fever, stool culture to exclude bacterial origin. Generated: if seen, send stool for culture/MC&S to exclude bacterial pathogens and consider targeted therapy. This is consistent with and expands the gold plan.
Gold: continue small sips ORT constantly. Generated: very small frequent sips, avoid large boluses. This is a more detailed version of the same advice.
Gold: avoid fruits, vegetables, and milk; generated adds bland, light foods such as toast/biscuits, in addition to the same avoidance. Core avoidance advice is supported; bland foods are additional.

Gold follow-up advises contacting clinic to arrange urgent A&E assessment if worse, abdo pain, unwell. Generated directly instructs attendance at A&E for specific signs (tachypnea, oliguria, dizziness, clinical deterioration) and IV fluids. Specific criteria and direct A&E self-presentation/IV fluid plan are additional detail.

Gold: if feels worse, abdo pain, unwell, contact clinic for urgent A&E assessment. Generated: safety-net to call back or present to A&E if symptoms worsen. This is consistent safety-net escalation, though the route differs slightly.
